name: Late-approved raise: July's difference carried into August (FR-PAY-17)
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: The person earns 30,000,000 and was raised to 33,000,000 from 1 July 2026, but the owner only approved it in August. July was already paid on the old salary, so the difference is carried into August as a retro line.
July's difference: 33,000,000 - 30,000,000 = 3,000,000 gross (July was a full month, so no pro-rating on either side).
August is paid on the new salary: BASE 33,000,000 x 2200 / (22 x 100) = 33,000,000.
RETRO_PAY 3,000,000 is taxable income of August (taxed in the month it is paid) but is NOT part of August's insurance base.
Insurance is on the declared base 33,000,000 only, well under the BHXH/BHYT cap of 20 x 2,530,000 = 50,600,000.
The item is flagged insuranceBaseChanged: July's declared base should have been 33,000,000, which payroll cannot put right — it belongs in the BHXH adjustment declaration (FR-PAY-35).
